messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Browse for filesystem
parts:
Then for that, maybe you could do something like this using file.choose:

library(shiny)

ui <- fluidPage(
  actionButton('browse', 'Browse'),
  textOutput("chosenPath")
)

server <- function(input, output, session) {
  filePath <- eventReactive(input$browse, {
    file.choose()
  })
  
  output$chosenPath <- renderText({
    filePath()
  })
}

shinyApp(ui, server)

This only works if the browser and the Shiny process are running on the same machine, since file.choose() will pop up the file dialog on the server, not on the client.

If you want to upload a file from the client, you can use fileInput().

If you want to choose a file that's on the server AND the browser and server aren't on the same machine, then neither of the previous approaches will work. If the data directory isn't too large, maybe you could list all of the possible files as choices in a selectInput. (Just make sure to verify that the user input that comes back is indeed in your data directory--it's always possible for a malicious visitor to ignore the valid choices your app provides and send arbitrary values to your app.)
